::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/email_report"}
#docs
Billing emails queued in [`start`, `end`] (civil days in the business timezone). Status counts are the delivery report's: `delivered` is an email marked sent on a transport that delivers (`smtp`, `ses`, `esp`); `bounced` excludes complaints, which count as `complained`; the rates divide by `attempted` (delivered + bounced + complained + failed). `link_visits` counts portal visits whose link came from an email, as the portal report's `arrival` does, and `recovered_minor` is the portal report's `recovered_from_failed_emails_minor`; both are null under a `transport` filter. `paid_after` counts invoices paid within `dunning.hold_days` days after a delivered email that asked for payment. Reasons hold stored provider and server responses with addresses removed; recipient domains are domains only. `tracked`, `opened`, `clicked`, `open_bps` and `click_bps` cover delivered emails sent while the business had `email_config.trackEngagement` on, once per email; a person's click counts as an open, and machine opens (mail privacy proxies, security scanners, prefetch) are counted apart in `machine_opened`. `tracking.covers_period` is false when the window starts before tracking began. `top_links` ranks links by people's clicks; link paths hold plain words only (ids and tokens show as `:id`) and no query string. With `compare=true`, `previous` holds the same figures for the same number of days just before. Money is integer minor units in `currency`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | `string` | **yes** | First civil day of the window, in the business timezone |
| `end` | `string` | **yes** | Last civil day of the window, inclusive. At most 366 days. |
| `compare` | `string` | no | Also return the previous window of the same length |
| `currency` | `string` | no | Report money in this currency only. Default: converted into the business currency |
| `type` | `string` | no | Only emails of this type, for example `payment_failed` |
| `transport` | `string` | no | Only emails sent by this transport; `unknown` = not recorded |
| `recent` | `integer` | no | How many recent emails to return (default 10) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `email_report`. One of `email_report`. |
| `business` | `string` | The business id. |
| `start` | `string` | The first day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `end` | `string` | The last day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `previous_start` | `string` | The first day of the previous window. |
| `previous_end` | `string` | The last day of the previous window. |
| `timezone` | `string` | The business time zone. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency of the money figures. |
| `missing_rates` | `array of string` | Currencies with no exchange rate, left out of the money figures. |
| `filters` | `object` | The filters applied. |
| `options` | `object` | Filter values seen in the window and the one before. |
| `totals` | `object` | The window's figures. |
| `previous` | `object` | The same figures for the previous window; null unless `compare=true`. |
| `tracking` | `object` | Open and click tracking for this business. |
| `top_links` | `array of object` | The most-clicked links of the window, by people's clicks. |
| `live` | `object` | Right now, whatever the window. |
| `days` | `array of object` | The window's days, in order. |
| `series` | `object` | Per-day figures, one per day in `days`. |
| `funnel` | `array of object` | Queued, delivered, opened, clicked, portal link opened, paid. Opened and clicked appear only when the window has tracked emails. |
| `by_type` | `array of object` | By email type. |
| `by_transport` | `array of object` | By transport. |
| `by_domain` | `array of object` | The ten busiest recipient domains. |
| `reasons` | `array of object` | Top reasons. |
| `skipped_reasons` | `array of object` | Skipped by reason. |
| `dunning` | `object` | The failed-payment email sequence: how many were sent at each position and how many invoices were paid after it. |
| `recent` | `array of object` | The newest emails in the window. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The email report |
| `400` | Invalid window |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/email_report?start=2026-03-14&end=2026-04-14" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
